title: Release Train - Weekly Prep / Go-No-Go Notes
body:
Context:
Quick prep notes for the Friday release-train sync (09:30 PT). This is my personal scratchpad for questions I want to raise and action items to confirm before the go/no-go call.

Meeting goals:
- Confirm go/no-go for Release 2026.04 
- Surface any last-minute blockers and owners
- Validate deployment windows, capacity, and rollback plan
- Lock on final smoke test checklist and monitoring alerts

Attendees (planned):
- Release captain: Elena Ruiz
- Infra / SRE: Samir Patel
- Serving runtime: Maya Singh
- QA / E2E: Noah Kim
- Product PM: Priya Kapoor
- Eng leads + on-call representatives as needed

Agenda draft:
1) Quick status round (30s per team) - highlight any RED items
2) Blockers & mitigations (5-10m)
3) Final checklist review (deployment, database migrations, feature flags) (10m)
4) Go / No-go poll (2m)
5) Post-announce plan & owners (5m)

Current RED / YELLOW items (notes + owners):
- Canary infra capacity: YELLOW - autoscale policy tested but peak load simulations show CPU at 82% on one pool. Owner: Samir. Mitigation: increase burst nodes during canary (approved) + monitor. TODO: Samir confirm nodes increased by 08:00 on deploy day.
- Model bundle regression: GREEN -> merged yesterday but there is one flaky test in conversation-context PR (github#1287). Owner: Maya. Action: backstop with canary traffic at 5% for first 30 minutes.
- Database migration (feature_flags.table_schema_v2): RED until migration dry-run completes. Owner: Elena. Note: dry-run scheduled 2026-04-16 02:00 PT. Need success sign-off before go.
- Alerting: YELLOW - new token-cost alert configured but threshold needs tuning. Owner: Noah. Action: tune in staging based on 24h traffic profile.

Go/No-go checklist (I'll call the poll against this list):
- [ ] All critical PRs merged and green (CI) - owner: eng leads (Maya/Elena) - status: yes (except flaky test flagged)
- [ ] DB migration dry-run successful - owner: Elena - status: pending (dry-run 04-16 02:00 PT)
- [ ] Infra capacity validated for canary + full deploy - owner: Samir - status: in-progress
- [ ] Rollback steps documented and tested - owner: Samir / Release captain - status: yes (playbook linked)
- [ ] Smoke tests for core flows (chat generation, embeddings, streaming) pass in staging - owner: Noah - status: in-progress (smoke suite 85/87 passing; investigating 2 fails)
- [ ] Observability / dashboards updated (per-route latency, token cost, error rate) - owner: Priya/Observability team - status: in-progress
- [ ] Security / secrets (KMS rotations, env checks) validated - owner: Security - status: yes

Deployment window & cadence:
- Canary start: 2026-04-17 10:00 PT (5% traffic, 30 minutes)
- Canary evaluation: 10:30 PT - evaluate errors, latency, token cost delta
- Ramp plan: 5% -> 20% (10m) -> 50% (15m) -> 100% (30m) if no regressions
- Forced rollback window: first 60 minutes after any ramp step if error rate > baseline + 1.5x or P95 latency + 80%

Rollback playbook (short):
- Step 1: Pause traffic routing to new model variant (routing controlled in console: route ID = rel-2026-04-17-canary)
- Step 2: Revert model tag to previous stable (tag: stable-2026-03)
- Step 3: Roll deployment back in infra control plane (Samir)
- Step 4: Run targeted smoke tests and validate alerts cleared (Noah)

Open questions I want to ask in the meeting:
- Does product want immediate feature-flag rollout for X (the new streaming response buffer)? If yes, we should schedule a separate feature-flag campaign after full ramp. (Priya)
- Can SRE confirm the autoscaler cooldown settings? We need faster scale-up for short bursts during canary. (Samir)
- Are there any compliance windows (audit / customer notify) this month that affect the deploy? (Legal / Customer Success)

Action items (author / owner / due):
- Elena: run DB migration dry-run (2026-04-16 02:00 PT) -> update this doc with pass/fail by 2026-04-16 04:00 PT.
- Samir: provision + validate additional burst nodes and confirm autoscaler cooldown change by 2026-04-16 12:00 PT.
- Maya: triage flaky test in github#1287 and add guardrail in smoke suite by 2026-04-16 EOD.
- Noah: finish smoke runs in staging, debug 2 failing tests, and post results by 2026-04-16 09:00 PT.
- Priya: update alert thresholds on staging and add visual comparison dashboard for token-cost delta by 2026-04-16 09:30 PT.
- Samir + Release captain: prepare on-call rota for deploy hours and confirm pager contacts by 2026-04-16 EOD.

Notes / quick links to paste in meeting:
- Confluence: April Release Train (linked)
- PR: platform/pull/1287 (model bundle)
- Migration ticket: RL-3421 (db migration)
- Slack thread: #release-train (last updates: 04/15)

My plan for the sync:
- Open with 60s status from each owner (call out only RED items)
- If DB migration fails in dry-run, immediate NO-GO and schedule follow-up with DB team - do not proceed to canary.
- If minor items (alerts thresholds, flaky tests), move forward with canary + hold at 5% for 30m and reevaluate.

Notes to self (post-meeting):
- Record decision in Confluence + tag RL-3432 (release record)
